start.description: Segment start time in seconds (from video start). The FIRST segment's start must be 0.

prompt.description: SFX / foley description for this segment.

end.description: Segment end time in seconds. Must equal the next segment's start (contiguous; no gaps/overlaps); the last segment's end must be <= the video duration.

segments.description: Optional. Split the video into time ranges, each with its own sound description. Leave empty to split into scenes automatically.

audio_format.description: Format of the returned audio file: aac (default), mp3, wav, or flac. (The video with sound is always AAC.)

video_url.description: The video to add sound to (public URL, or upload a file). The generated audio matches the video's length.

keep_speech_vocal.description: Keep the original video's speech/vocals. When on, the source audio is separated (music source separation) and the isolated vocals are kept as recorded, with the generated sound mixed in at a level matched to the voice; the rest of the original soundtrack (music, ambience) is dropped. Applies to the returned audio and video. When off (default), the result carries only the generated sound.

prompt.description: Optional. Describe the kind of sound you want; it steers the generated audio for every scene. Leave empty to caption the video automatically.
